title: Registration and orientation
summary: Orientation confirms delivery only after context emission. Each harness writes the exact merged and budgeted context body's UTF-8 byte_count and SHA-256 into the existing delivered marker, without storing the body. Receiving QA reads the marker on its retained host through qa mission host-command, including Cursor where transcripts omit hook bodies. Emission evidence remains distinct from native receiving proof, which waits for released QA.
